wrapper.name: SceneResource_ProcessCommandStreamWithPresentationScratch
wrapper.contract: Set the presentation scratch byte, invoke the common scene-resource command interpreter, clear the byte, and return.

scratch.name: SCENE_RESOURCE_PRESENTATION_SCRATCH
scratch.lifetime: only across the nested SceneResource_ProcessCommandStream call
scratch.effect: When set, object-command records invoke SceneResource_ObjectCommandNoOpHook before VDP_WriteTileWord.

conclusion: The small interpreter-boundary gap is a reusable presentation-mode wrapper, not opaque data; its scratch lifetime and no-op hook are now explicit.
